name: @openhut/desktop
description: Self-hosted agents for a team, on this computer.
author: OpenHut

scripts.build: npm -w @openhut/app run build && rm -rf dist/renderer && mkdir -p dist && cp -R ../app/dist dist/renderer
scripts.prove: npm run build && npm run pack-backend && node scripts/app-e2e.mjs --dev --out /tmp/openhut-prove --cloud ../../private/api
scripts.sums: cd dist && { find renderer -type f; find backend -name '*.mjs' -not -path '*/node_modules/*' -not -path 'backend/runtime/*'; } | LC_ALL=C sort | xargs shasum -a 256 > SHA256SUMS && shasum -a 256 SHA256SUMS
scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run pack-backend && npm run sums && electron-builder --mac --arm64 --publish never
scripts.dist:dev: npm run build && npm run pack-backend && npm run sums && electron-builder --mac --arm64 --config electron-builder.dev.yml --publish never
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && npm run pack-backend && electron-builder --win --x64 -c.extraMetadata.name=openhut --publish never
scripts.dist:linux: umask 022 && npm run build && npm run pack-backend && electron-builder --linux --x64 -c.electronFuses.runAsNode=true --publish never
